response.sql: SELECT p.SEX, AVG(CAST(l.DNA AS DECIMAL)) AS avg_dna, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS avg_alb_minus_tp FROM Laboratory l INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.`T-CHO` > 180 GROUP BY p.SEX

assumptions.assumption: DNA column contains numeric values or NULL; CAST to DECIMAL will handle conversion correctly despite DNA being stored as TEXT
